evals.prompt: Add a Payload CMS readiness check against a lightweight users collection query and integrate it into an existing manager.
evals.expected_output: A deterministic payloadHealthCheck configuration using default small query behavior and readiness semantics with tests.
expectations: Uses a small limit and depth zero with explicit collection rationale.
Tests exact query arguments and readiness status.

evals.prompt: A settings collection must contain one document, while an optional drafts collection may be empty. Define the correct expectedMinDocuments behavior.
evals.expected_output: Separate explicit semantics where only the real singleton invariant fails on zero documents.
expectations: Uses expectedMinDocuments only for the required settings record.
Keeps empty optional collection success semantics.
Tests numeric and malformed totalDocs when a minimum exists.

evals.prompt: Review a Payload health check in liveness that performs a deep business query, exposes raw database causes publicly, and assumes timeout cancels the query.
evals.expected_output: A review that moves the check to readiness, reduces query cost, suppresses causes, and documents cooperative timeout limits.
expectations: Rejects external Payload dependency as default liveness behavior.
States that manager timeout does not cancel payload.find.

evals.prompt: Diagnose why a timed-out Payload check reports CHECK_TIMEOUT instead of PAYLOAD_QUERY_FAILED and why its latencyMs is missing from Prometheus.
evals.expected_output: A manager timeout and collector-only export boundary diagnosis.
expectations: Explains manager timeout normalization and timedOut metadata.
Distinguishes check-local metrics from report collector metrics.
Does not add exporter exceptions for the adapter.

evals.prompt: Add managed slug, Jalali date, and money fields to a Payload collection.
evals.expected_output: A handoff to payload-fields skills without applying the health adapter contract.
expectations: Recognizes this as Payload field-factory work, not healthcheck-payload.
Routes to the relevant payload-fields skills.
Does not introduce payload.find health probes.
